package.author: Jiesi Ma
package.description: Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them, offline.

en-US.author: Jiesi Ma
en-US.description: Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them, offline.
en-US.longDescription: Can't find subtitles for a video? Wave Subs recognizes the dialogue with whisper.cpp, refines the timing, and translates the result into your language with a local Qwen3 model (or any OpenAI-compatible API). Exports SRT / ASS next to the video, batch-processes a whole season, and includes a subtitle editor with video preview. Everything runs on your own computer: no account, no upload, no internet needed after the one-time model download. Free and open source (MIT).
en-US.name: Wave Subs
en-US.releaseNotes:
Wave Subs 1.0.9
Windows
- 用户名里有中文（或日文、韩文、俄文、带重音的字母）时，语音识别一开始就崩溃，退出码 3221226505。之前所有 Windows 版本都有这个问题，现在修好了（#1）
- VAD 语音检测同样修好。以后它万一跑不起来，质检里会明确提示，不再悄悄降低时间轴的精度
- 转换时不再弹出黑色的命令行窗口
- 画面文字识别在中文、日文、韩文 Windows 上可能完全用不了，开关也不显示，现在修好了
其它
- 识别没有产出结果时，报错里带上识别程序自己的日志，不再只说「文件不存在」
Windows
- Speech recognition crashed right at the start (exit code 3221226505) when the Windows user name contained Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic or accented characters. Every earlier Windows version was affected; this is fixed (#1)
- Speech detection is fixed the same way. Should it ever fail to run, the quality report now says so instead of quietly lowering timing precision
- No more black console windows during a conversion
- On-screen text could be unusable on Chinese, Japanese and Korean Windows, with its switch hidden; this is fixed
Other
- When recognition produces no result, the error now includes the recognizer's own log instead of only "file not found"

zh-CN.description: 用本地 AI 从影片生成 SRT/ASS 字幕并自动翻译，无需联网。
zh-CN.longDescription: 看片找不到字幕？Wave Subs 用 whisper.cpp 识别对白、精修时间轴，再用本地 Qwen3 模型（或任何 OpenAI 兼容接口）翻译成你的语言。导出 SRT / ASS 到影片旁边，整季批量处理，自带带视频预览的字幕编辑器。全部在你自己的电脑上完成：没有账号、不上传、模型下载后无需联网。免费开源（MIT）。
